name: SailPoint Identity Security Engineer
aligned: Aligned to the SailPoint Certified Identity Security Engineer exam prep guide
notice: Independent study project, not affiliated with or endorsed by SailPoint Technologies, Inc. SailPoint, Identity Security Cloud and IdentityNow are trademarks of SailPoint Technologies, Inc.; other names are trademarks of their owners.
weights_note: SailPoint's exam prep guide lists the sections and objectives but no weights. Practice exams weight each section by its number of official objectives (8 / 9 / 3 / 12 / 7 / 7 / 10 / 5 / 5 / 4); PROJECTED. The grouping of official objectives into course objectives is this course's own.

objectives.1.2: Identity attributes, manager correlation and attribute rules
objectives.1.3: Lifecycle state design for joiners and leavers
objectives.2.1: Provisioning outcomes and role assignment behavior
objectives.2.2: Provisioning policies, attribute sync and multiple accounts
objectives.2.3: Provisioning testing, troubleshooting and best practices
objectives.3.1: Access management testing, reminders, escalations and segments
objectives.4.2: VA setup, keys and valid configurations
objectives.5.1: Connector types, Active Directory and JDBC configuration
objectives.5.2: Aggregation flow and controlling data sent to the cloud
objectives.5.3: Service desk integration and connectivity troubleshooting
objectives.6.1: IGA, compliance, authentication, authorization and federation
objectives.7.1: API gateway, authentication methods and user levels
objectives.7.2: Search, email configuration, monitoring and activity records
objectives.8.1: Certification preparation, types and data issues
objectives.8.2: Access request approvers and separation of duties
objectives.9.1: Data security, encryption and component redundancy
objectives.9.2: System communication, valid URLs and multi-tenant processing

pass_label: SailPoint grades pass or fail; this course uses 70 % as a readiness target
exam_questions_note: Up to 73 discrete option multiple choice (DOMC) questions, up to 120 minutes, online proctored; the exam ends early once enough answers decide the result (SailPoint exam prep guide, checked 2026-11-06). Practice exams use 73 questions in 120 minutes.

exam_target.name: SailPoint Certified Identity Security Engineer
exam_target.note: No retirement date is announced. Identity Security Cloud. Up to 73 DOMC questions, up to 120 minutes, online proctored, pass or fail; USD 400; at least 1 year of hands-on experience recommended (SailPoint, checked 2026-11-06). SailPoint's 2026 documentation calls the product SailPoint Human Fabric (previously known as Identity Security Cloud); the certifications keep the Identity Security names, and this course uses Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
